description: This file defines the AdvancedPaymentAllocationsJsonParser class, which is responsible for parsing JSON input related to advanced payment allocations in a loan product context, including validating and assembling payment allocation rules.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentAllocationsJsonParser
classes.description: A service class that parses JSON commands to generate payment allocation rules for loan products, while performing validation.

methods.name: assembleLoanProductPaymentAllocationRules
methods.description: Parses the 'paymentAllocation' array from the JSON command, creates and populates LoanProductPaymentAllocationRule objects, and validates the list.

methods.name: populatePaymentAllocationRules
methods.description: Populates the allocation types of a payment allocation rule based on JSON array data.

methods.name: populateFutureInstallment
methods.description: Sets the future installment allocation rule based on a string value from JSON.

methods.name: populateTransactionType
methods.description: Sets the transaction type for a payment allocation rule based on JSON input.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationTypes
methods.description: Extracts, sorts, and validates payment allocation types from a JSON array, returning the list of types.

methods.name: asIntegerOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to Integer if not null.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to String if not null.

methods.name: asJsonArrayOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to JsonArray if not null.
